 and Registrar's  order with  Signatures  09/06/ ABA No. 246 of 2025  2025 Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.

The present Application has been filed by the applicant Surya Prakash Arya seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No. 139 of 2022, registered at Police Station Pathri, District Haridwar under Sections 323, 354, 376, 506 and Section 342 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

2. Heard Mr. Devansh Kaushik, learned counsel holding brief of Mr. Parikshit Saini, learned counsel for the applicant and Mr. G.S. Sandhu, learned Additional Advocate General assisted by Mr. Deepak Bhardwaj, learned Brief Holder for the State.
3.

Mr. G.S. Sandhu, Additional Advocate General, submitted on instructions, received from the Investigating Officer, that a closure report has been filed by the Investigating Officer in the present matter.
4. After the said submissions, Mr. Devansh Kaushik, Advocate, has requested to permit the applicant to withdraw the present anticipatory bail application.
5. The Anticipatory Bail Application (ABA No.246 of 2025) is dismissed as withdrawn.

(Alok Kumar Verma, J.) 09.06.2025 Shiv/ 2025:UHC:4706 ABA/246/2025 on 9 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/195369323/
